key.name: instant-catch
key.description: Bypasses the drag threshold when an animation is in flight, immediately latching to the animation upon touch.

key.name: preserve-delta
key.description: Applies the accumulated movement distance rather than discarding it upon gesture recognition.

key.name: allow-long-swipes
key.description: Allows fluid gestures across multiple workspaces and rapid consecutive flicks.

key.name: velocity-matching
key.description: Calculates deceleration curves matching instantaneous finger release velocity.

key.name: gentle-rest-release
key.description: Uses an ease-in-out curve when fingers are stationary at release to prevent abrupt kicks.

key.name: catch-keyboard-switches
key.description: Allows touchpad swipes to seamlessly interrupt programmatic or keyboard workspace animations.

key.name: speed-multiplier
key.description: Multiplier applied to gesture swipe delta.

key.name: flick-threshold
key.description: Minimum distance in pixels required to recognize a directional flick gesture.

key.name: flick-time-window
key.description: Maximum gesture duration in milliseconds to be recognized as a flick.

key.name: hold-drag-threshold
key.description: Distance in pixels to transition from a flick window into 1:1 interactive hold-drag during an animation.
